Tier2 link conversion with accessible names enabled

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use HtmlToMarkdown\HtmlToMarkdown;
use HtmlToMarkdown\ConversionOptions;
$options = \HtmlToMarkdown\ConversionOptions::from_json(json_encode(["inlineDataMedia" => "AltTextOnly", "tierStrategy" => "tier2"]));
$result = HtmlToMarkdown::convertWithAccessibleNames("<p>see <a href=\"https://example.com/x\">GitHub<svg aria-label=\"(opens in new tab)\"><use href=\"#ext\"></use></svg></a> now</p>", true, $options);
var_dump($result->content);
```
